reviews.review:
This game is a blast, especially when you're playing with friends or family. It can be pretty challenging at times, but that's part of what makes it so fun—the grind feels rewarding instead of frustrating.

To me, it feels like a mix of Dungeon Defenders and games like Mega Bonk or Sineus. It has its own style, but if you've played those, you'll probably enjoy this too.

Overall, it's a great game that I'd definitely recommend trying. If you're looking for something fun to grind with friends, this is absolutely worth checking out.

reviews.review:
generally a fun goofy game, sadly there are a few things that make the game extremely frustrating .
1. Both Agility Heros are unusable trash, not barely the same damage potential as the other heros.
2. the loss of max HP on death made the game just worse
3. the game is not well optimized

In the begining the game looked so promising, but the sheer volume of issues together with the absolute trash sense of humour (2010 Boomer Memes) that the whole game is based upon, makes it no longer a fun and whacky game
reviews.developer_response: Thanks for the review! We have a massive update coming out August 11 that should address most of your feedback. We are introducing a mechanic for you to remove the Health Penalty (2 different ways to do that). Also we have been working a ton on optimizing the game and it runs a lot better. We have also rebalanced the difficulties and enemies and classes. Hope you will check it out and let us know what you think!
